PR: bugfix(memcached): Make `memcached` batch fetch truely context aware [closed; labels size/L]
**What this PR does / why we need it**:
Currently, `Fetch` method of memcached is not truely respecting the `ctx` passed to it. It get lost in `fetchKeysBatched` method
https://github.com/grafana/loki/blob/489ac8d529ec39352/pkg/storage/chunk/cache/memcached.go#L171-L226

So even if client cancels the context, memcached would still be fetching keys.

This PR make it respect context cancelation.

Changes:
1. Add select case to check for `ctx.Done()` before submitting work to `inputCh`.
2. Given, now …

point to stop the mecached actor one via old `Stop()` method and other via context cancel, I Added aditional flag `stopped` to make sure we are not closing channels that are already closed.
3. Updated tests to lock this behaviour.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes NA

**Special notes for your reviewer**:
This bug played a role in some incident recently on our Loki SaaS. cc @slim-bean
